name: Complete a connection
description: Finishes connecting an account the user approved at the provider. After approval the venue gives the browser a one-time completion code: an app named in returnTo receives it, otherwise the venue's page shows it for the user to give back. Only the account that started the connect can complete it; any other caller is refused and the code is used up. Returns the connection as oauth:status reports it.

code.description: The one-time completion code from the venue's callback — not the provider's authorization code

refreshable.description: True when a refresh token is held, so the connection outlives the access token

expiresAt.description: Epoch millis when the current access token expires; 0 when the provider reports no expiry

obtained.description: Epoch millis when the connection was stored
